title: [review] COSE to_cose_sign1 re-derives unprotected kid from mutable fields while emitting retained wire payload
description: Edge-review of y2a2 (pass 3), distinct failure mode from the verify-side desync. to_cose_sign1 emits verbatim retained payload_bytes but re-derives the unprotected kid from LIVE mutable fields: capability_announcements.py:210 (kid from self.payload.announcer_iid), delegation_tokens.py:249 + :583 (delegator_iid), key_rotation_attestation.py:187 (old_iid), root_dio_signature.py:217 (root_iid). After a payload/field swap the emitted blob has kid inconsistent with the retained signed payload, so the module's own from_cose_sign1 rejects its own re-encoding (e.g. capability_announcements.py:254 kid==announcer_iid check). Encode-side self-inconsistency. Fix: emit retained bytes fully consistently, or reject re-encode when fields diverge from retained bstrs; resolved by the same freeze/derive fix as 2vp1.
